description: RSAF Lightning F.53 53-699, installed on a plinth at Tabuk by BAe in August 1985 (Lightning Association), which matches local history that the Tabuk Airplane Roundabout was built in 1985. Painted with 2 Squadron code 227. Photographed at the base entrance 4 Jan 2019 (JetPhotos 9190192, captioned 227 / 53-699) and 16 Feb 2018 (Wikimedia Commons). Wikipedia gives the roundabout position 28.387229 36.594182.
museum_name: King Faisal Air Base Airplane Roundabout
